JOB SUMMARY
· Owns a major area of the BSWH AI use-case roadmap and is accountable for translating customer jobs-to-be-done into AI-powered experiences that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and business value.
· Leads prioritization, roadmap development, requirements definition, launch planning, and success measurement for AI-enabled capabilities across one or more customer journey areas.
· Works closely with Digital, Journey, Clinical, Analytics, Data, Ontology, Architecture, Engineering, and Operations teams to define, deliver, and continuously improve AI-powered customer experiences.
· Ensures AI capabilities solve meaningful customer problems, achieve measurable outcomes, and are designed for safe, scalable, and reusable implementation across BSWH use cases.
· Drives alignment across stakeholders while balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, operational constraints, regulatory requirements, and enterprise priorities.
· Partners with AI platform and architecture teams to leverage reusable AI capabilities while maintaining accountability for customer and business outcomes within the assigned product area.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE
AI Use Case Product Strategy & Roadmap
· Own the product strategy, roadmap, and backlog for one or more priority AI use-case areas.
· Translate customer, operational, and clinical problems into clear jobs-to-be-done, product requirements, delivery priorities, and measurable outcomes.
· Define success metrics and key performance indicators that measure business impact, customer value, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, and operational improvement.
· Identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities where AI can create differentiated customer experiences or operational advantages.
· Develop business cases and prioritization frameworks that balance strategic value, implementation complexity, risk, dependency management, and expected return.
Customer Outcomes & Jobs-to-Be-Done Ownership
· Lead discovery efforts to understand customer needs, stakeholder requirements, operational workflows, and pain points that can be addressed through AI-enabled capabilities.
· Frame AI use cases as concrete customer jobs-to-be-done and ensure each use case has a clear problem statement, target outcome, measurable success criteria, and responsible stakeholders.
· Partner with customer journey leaders, clinical and operational subject matter experts, and analytics teams to validate that proposed capabilities address the right problems.
· Ensure product decisions stay grounded in customer value, clinical/operational integrity, and measurable business impact rather than technology novelty alone.
AI Capability Definition & Experience Design
· Define AI-enabled product capabilities, workflows, agent behaviors, escalation paths, guardrails, and customer experiences for assigned AI use cases.
· Translate strategy into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, success metrics, and delivery priorities that engineering and AI teams can execute against.
· Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to determine when solutions should use orchestration, retrieval, deterministic rules, personalization, automation, or human review.
· Partner with design, research, and customer experience teams to ensure AI-powered interactions are understandable, helpful, trustworthy, and aligned with BSWH experience standards.
Cross-Functional Delivery & Adoption
· Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Journey, Clinical, Analytics, Data, Ontology, Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Operations teams.
· Manage roadmap tradeoffs across customer experience, speed of delivery, technical complexity, operational readiness, safety, compliance, and long-term scalability.
· Communicate product vision, roadmap priorities, delivery progress, risks, launch readiness, and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders.
· Support launch planning, adoption, training, stakeholder readiness, and operational handoffs for AI-enabled capabilities.
Evaluation, Measurement & Continuous Improvement
· Define expected AI behaviors, quality expectations, guardrails, and acceptance criteria in partnership with clinical, operational, technical, and AI quality stakeholders.
· Partner with engineering, analytics, and AI quality teams to establish evaluation approaches, testing criteria, performance expectations, and feedback loops.
· Monitor AI capability performance, adoption, customer outcomes, operational outcomes, and quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
· Drive iterative improvement using customer feedback, evaluation results, product analytics, operational insights, and experimentation results.
Platform Reuse & Enterprise Alignment
· Work with AI platform, architecture, data, ontology, and engineering teams to ensure assigned use cases leverage reusable enterprise AI capabilities where appropriate.
· Identify reusable capabilities, patterns, or requirements that should be shared across multiple AI use cases or product areas.
· Help prevent duplicated work by connecting use-case needs to common platform capabilities, integration patterns, evaluation approaches, and governance standards.
· Ensure product decisions support both near-term use-case delivery and BSWH’s longer-term AI strategy.
KEY SUCCESS FACTORS
· Proven ability to define product strategies that translate customer problems into measurable business and customer outcomes.
· Demonstrated success owning complex digital product areas with accountability for adoption, customer experience, and operational impact.
· Strong product judgment and prioritization skills, particularly in environments with competing stakeholder needs, technical uncertainty, and resource constraints.
· Ability to translate ambiguous customer, business, clinical, or operational needs into clear product requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans.
· Strong understanding of AI-enabled products and how AI capabilities can be used to improve customer journeys, operational processes, and decision support.
· Experience partnering with engineering, architecture, analytics, data, clinical, and operations teams to deliver complex technology-enabled solutions.
· Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to align diverse groups around common objectives without relying on formal authority.
· Ability to balance short-term delivery needs with long-term product, platform, and enterprise AI strategy.
· Comfort operating in a regulated or high-trust environment where safety, privacy, compliance, auditability, and customer trust are critical.
BENEFITS
Our competitive benefits package includes the following
- Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits
- 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%
- Tuition Reimbursement
- PTO accrual beginning Day 1
Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Education
· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
· Master’s degree preferred.
Experience
· 8–12 years of product management experience.
· Demonstrated ownership of digital products, platforms, customer experiences, or technology-enabled services with measurable business impact.
· Experience managing complex cross-functional roadmaps involving product, engineering, design, analytics, data, and business stakeholders.
· Experience working with AI-enabled products, machine learning systems, conversational experiences, personalization platforms, automation solutions, search experiences, recommendation systems, or decision-support technologies.
· Strong experience translating customer and business needs into structured product requirements, prioritized roadmaps, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
· Experience defining and measuring product success using KPIs, customer outcomes, business metrics, usage analytics, and qualitative customer insights.
· Healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated-industry experience preferred but not required.
Required Technical Expertise
· Strong understanding of AI-enabled product development and modern AI capabilities, including where AI can and cannot reliably improve customer or operational outcomes.
· Familiarity with concepts such as large language models, AI agents, orchestration, retrieval, personalization, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
· Product ownership across the full lifecycle, including strategy, discovery, requirements, prioritization, delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization.
· Experience working with APIs, integrations, enterprise systems, data products, analytics, and platform capabilities that support reusable product development.
· Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, architects, data teams, analytics teams, clinical stakeholders, and operational stakeholders.
· Strong analytical skills and comfort interpreting performance data, customer metrics, adoption trends, quality signals, and product outcomes.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
· Experience owning AI-powered customer experiences, digital assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, search experiences, workflow automation products, or decision-support capabilities.
· Experience applying Jobs-to-Be-Done, customer-centered design, design thinking, agile product development, or outcome-based product management methodologies.
· Familiarity with AI product evaluation approaches, including quality measurement, experimentation, benchmark definition, feedback loops, and performance optimization.
· Experience operating in healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or similarly regulated environments involving sensitive data, safety requirements, auditability, and compliance considerations.
· Experience launching products involving AI models, enterprise systems, APIs, cross-functional delivery teams, and operational adoption requirements.
· Experience working with product analytics, experimentation frameworks, customer research, behavioral insights, and customer experience measurement.
· Strong ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across business, technology, clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders.

GSK’s Enterprise AI team turns the promise of AI into measurable impact across drug discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercial. Forward deployed teams embed with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

  

This role sits in Chemical Manufacturing & Control (CMC), the function that turns a validated molecule into a reliably manufactured, quality-assured medicine. Its current mission is to double New Product Introductions (NPIs).

  

As Staff AI Product Manager, you’ll own a major slice of our opportunity portfolio, shaping how AI transforms GSK’s process development worldwide. With business stakeholders, you’ll prioritize opportunities by feasibility and value, then structure the problem, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer (FDE) can build against.

  

You’ll own 10x transformational opportunities in process development acceleration: co-leading self-driving labs and digital twins, advancing in silico modeling and platform models (not point solutions), and agentifying high-value R&D workflows such as document authoring. Working closely with process science data analytics and R&D Tech, you’ll bring creativity grounded in business reality and the execution to deliver measurable impact.

  

**Why This Role Exists**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. This role ensures our engineers work on the right things. You will:

* Own a domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identify, size, and shape its highest-value AI opportunities.
* Partner daily with FDE and full-stack engineering leads to steer engagements end-to-end.
* Build the business and executive alignment FDEs need to land and scale.

  

**Responsibilities:**  
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:  

* **Find high-value AI opportunities** in your domain and rank them by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously** with business cases that withstand finance and senior leadership scrutiny.
* **Spot AI-shaped problems** in workflows before the business has articulated them.
* **Co-lead the self-driving labs redesign,** defining the 2033 vision and roadmap for lab automation with FDE pods and automation teams.
* **Drive 10x in silico modeling** by co-leading the digital twin agenda with an end-to-end platform mindset.
* **Accelerate molecule onboarding** by defining platform fitness and tracking progress toward halving development time.
* **Shape your domain’s portfolio,** keeping a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities.
* **Make trade-off recommendations** when sponsors compete for FDE pods, backed by clear metrics and analysis.
* **Protect engineering focus** by pushing back, with evidence, on low-impact opportunities.
* **Partner with FDE and full-stack leads,** turning ambiguous problems into clear problem statements, prototypes, and success metrics.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end:** scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling paths.
* **Drive reuse** by turning one-off solutions into platform capabilities.
* **Engage VP-level leaders** to turn ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change commitment, and air cover.
* **Communicate impact** in terms of patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.
* **Apply the value-realization framework** to every engagement and refine it as you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons into opportunity selection.

**Why You?**  
**Basic Qualification**  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in technology, computer science, product management, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience across pharmaceutical or life sciences, artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) product strategy, or senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organizations.
* Experience leading technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding and into delivery.
* Experience working in at least one area of the pharmaceutical value chain: research and development (R&D), clinical, manufacturing, or commercial.
* Experience applying AI/ML technologies such as large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, knowledge graphs, or data engineering.
* Experience building business cases and sizing value for R&D initiatives.
* Experience in product management or product strategy, including opportunity sizing, roadmap development, and prototyping.
* Experience with modeling, digital twins, self-driving labs, or physical AI initiatives in pharmaceutical R&D or process development, including defining pilots and evaluating results with scientists.
* Experience defining a vision and roadmap for self-driving labs and lab automation in partnership with scientists and automation teams.
* Experience partnering with data analytics, data science, or process science teams on modeling, optimization, and simulation.
* Experience working as a senior individual contributor, leading through influence rather than direct reports.

  
**  
Preferred Qualification**  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  

* Master's or PhD in technology, computer science, product management, or a related field.
* Ability to use evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineering choices and scope work realistically.
* Experience leading AI opportunity discovery and problem framing across a major domain such as research and development (R&D), clinical, or supply chain, including building a pipeline ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* Experience co-leading self-driving lab or lab automation initiatives, including automating experiment planning, execution, and data capture, and linking labs to in silico models.
* Experience building value cases and investment recommendations that withstand finance and senior leadership scrutiny, and managing an opportunity portfolio.
* Experience scoping AI engagements end to end, including success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways, and turning one-off solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
* Technical fluency in AI/machine learning, data, and evaluation design, with hands-on use of AI tools and command-line interfaces to automate daily work.
* Experience working within good practice (GxP), regulatory, and data-governance requirements in a regulated environment.
* Experience influencing vice president-level leaders without direct authority, communicating AI impact in terms of patients, science, and business outcomes, and using outcome tracking and post-mortems to improve future work.  
    

  

Work Arrangement  
This role follows a hybrid working model based in the United States. You will spend scheduled time on-site to collaborate and engage with your team and stakeholders. Fully remote work is not available for this position.

The Team
Zora AI™ by Deloitte is Deloitte's agentic AI platform, delivering role- and function-specific products - including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Customer, and Human Capital - built on the NVIDIA AI stack and underpinned by Deloitte's Trustworthy AI™ framework.
Position Summary
As a Senior Consultant Product Manager focused on Sourcing & Procurement, you own the delivery of an agentic product area within the procurement portfolio end-to-end at the feature and workstream level. You contribute to and help shape the vision and roadmap set by the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery, and bring deep procurement understanding to every decision - all while ensuring trust, adoption, and measurable business outcomes for enterprise users. You'll operate hands-on inside an agile product team, coordinate closely across engineering, data science, design, and risk, and mentor Consultants and Analysts as you go. The role sits where procurement domain knowledge meets agentic AI, turning real practitioner pain points into digital workers that get work done.
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/26.
Work you'll do
Product ownership & value delivery
+ Own the delivery of a defined sourcing and procurement product/agent area, and contribute to the product vision, strategy, and 12-18 month roadmap led by the Product Lead.
+ Define and track KPIs tied to procurement efficiency, cost reduction, and supplier performance; use data to continuously refine direction and retire low-value work.
+ Drive features that address end-to-end procurement workflows - requisition, sourcing and RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding and collaboration, and purchase-to-pay.
+ Translate business needs into outcomes: identify high-value use cases, map workflows, and define "jobs to be done" with measurable success metrics.
Domain expertise & user engagement
+ Develop and apply deep understanding of procurement processes (direct/indirect sourcing, RFx, spend analytics, supplier management, P2P) to credibly lead product decisions.
+ Conduct user research and competitive analysis across procurement platforms to surface unmet needs and opportunities.
+ Engage directly with procurement practitioners, category managers, and finance stakeholders to translate pain points into prioritized solutions.
Discovery & delivery
+ Run discovery (research, prototypes, Alphas) and delivery (MVP to scale) for your product area, managing scope, tradeoffs, and dependencies across engineering, data, and design.
+ Create clear PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams for agent behaviors, tool integrations, and user experiences.
+ Maintain a healthy, well-prioritized backlog; run sprint planning, track progress, remove blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned through clear decision points.
Agent experience & orchestration
+ Specify agent capabilities (reasoning, task planning, tool use, approvals), human-in-the-loop patterns, and escalation/exception handling for procurement workflows.
+ Partner with engineering and data teams on requirements for connectors, data access patterns, security/privacy, logging/auditability, and integration with enterprise procurement and ERP systems.
Trustworthy AI & risk
+ Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to address model governance, safety, monitoring, explainability, bias, and audit requirements, aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework.
Go-to-market & enablement
+ Collaborate with sales, alliances, and delivery to package offerings, create demos, and support pursuits, pilots, and launches; contribute inputs to pricing and packaging.
AI-augmented ways of working
+ Use AI to accelerate domain research, synthesize supplier and spend-data insights, and rapidly prototype and validate procurement workflow improvements.

You will sit with business leaders, understand how their work actually gets done, and decide where AI and agentic technology can make the biggest difference. Then you will own delivery end to end - discovery, build, evaluation, production deployment, and ongoing performance management - working hands-on with agentic frameworks, LLM-based workflows, and commercial data pipelines. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and commercial strategy. You will make your own feasibility and build-vs-buy calls, define what “good” looks like for non-deterministic AI systems, and move solutions from proof-of-concept into governed, monitored production use. Success is measured by adopted capabilities and quantified commercial impact. We're looking for clear thinkers who combine commercial awareness with practical delivery skills - someone business leaders trust and technologists respect. This is a chance to shape where GSK invests in AI across market access, in support of our mission to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
